ValidationRule.description: This verification rule works when the non profit status as Verified - Not in Good Standing and Not Verified.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Non_Profit_Status__c, "Verified - Not in Good Standing"), ISPICKVAL(Non_Profit_Status__c, "Not Verified") ), LEN(Non_Profit_Status_Verification_Notes__c) = 0 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide a reason for the selected non-profit status.
